objective: Decide whether Luna medium fast/priority service can replace default service for the final RepoTracer evaluation without a material Scout quality loss.

execution.provider: real Codex subscription through codex app-server
execution.source: one identical tracked snapshot of the current RepoTracer worktree per repeat and arm
execution.prompt_policy: Byte-identical query and retained adaptive-evidence Scout prompt across tiers. Only service tier differs.

tasks.query: Trace one repo_scout MCP request from JSON-RPC dispatch through the Scout backend to the structured response. Include cancellation and citation validation boundaries.
Trace a subscription Scout app-server session from process spawn through dynamic repository tool calls, stream activity tracking, token accounting, and process-tree cleanup.
Trace a direct Scout model tool request through tool schema construction, bounded concurrent execution, returned evidence, and final citation validation.
Trace repotracer setup from CLI dispatch through integration selection, generated configuration, dry-run behavior, and uninstall cleanup.
Trace the self-update lifecycle from the MCP startup check through release selection, checksum verification, binary replacement, and integration refresh.
Trace the subscription inactivity timeout from configuration through stream activity refresh and complete process-tree termination. Distinguish inactivity from total runtime.
Find the exact current workspace and npm package version declarations. Cite only the files that directly declare those values.
Find the exact documented one-command installation and dry-run commands. Cite the smallest relevant README locations.

quality.rubric: Blind 0-4: 4 complete and accurate with material boundaries; 3 one minor omission; 2 a required stage missing; 1 fragments; 0 wrong or unusable.
quality.blinding: Opaque IDs hide arm and repeat until every score is locked.

decision_rule.quality_floor: Fast mean blind quality may be at most 0.25/4 below default, with no new score-2-or-lower required-boundary failure.
decision_rule.citation_floor: Fast valid citation rate must remain 100%; mean expected-path recall may fall by at most 0.10.
decision_rule.time_gate: Fast must reduce paired median wall time by at least 10% and be faster in at least 16 of 24 matched pairs.
decision_rule.cost_read: Report exact provider-log aggregate by requested/actual tier. Do not attribute stochastic token-volume differences to tier pricing.

failure_policy.infrastructure: Provider, harness, or source setup failure resamples the complete matched pair.
failure_policy.model: Timeout, malformed output, missing evidence, or poor answer remains a scored outcome.
failure_policy.retention: Keep losing and invalidated attempts under private artifacts.
